system.description: Once per turn, when you take damage from a creature you can see, you can spend 2 Nature Energy, growing booster jets on your back, and move up to 30 feet in a straight line towards the triggering creature. If you end this movement within 5 feet of the triggering creature, they trigger an attack of opportunity from you.
